mapper.select: select d.dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,t.tax_rate taxRate,coalesce(t.version,0) version,t.update_by updateBy,t.update_time updateTime from sys_dept d left join biz_company_profit_tax t on t.company_dept_id=d.dept_id where d.parent_id=100 and d.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' and (d.leader_user_id=#{userId} or exists( select 1 from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.role_key='company_owner' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0')) order by d.order_num,d.dept_id
select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0' for update
select tax_rate taxRate,version from biz_company_profit_tax where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_company_profit_tax(company_dept_id,tax_rate,update_by) values(#{companyDeptId},#{taxRate},#{userName}) on duplicate key update tax_rate=values(tax_rate),version=version+1,update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()
mapper.select: select p.project_id projectId,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId,coalesce(t.tax_rate,0) taxRate, case when t.company_dept_id is null then '0' else '1' end configured, coalesce((select sum(r.profit_amount) from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=p.project_id and r.is_current='1'),0) pretaxProfit from biz_project p left join biz_company_profit_tax t on t.company_dept_id=p.company_dept_id where p.project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_profit_tax_snapshot(project_id,company_dept_id,tax_rate,configured,pretax_profit,tax_amount,aftertax_profit,create_by) values(#{projectId},#{companyDeptId},#{taxRate},#{configured},#{pretaxProfit},#{taxAmount},#{afterTaxProfit},#{userName}) on duplicate key update project_id=values(project_id)
